heroTitle:
Situdiyo ya software
yizibanda ku bikoresho
heroSub: FiveStar AI ikora ibikoresho bya iOS n'ibikoresho byo koroshya imirimo. Tutanga ibyo abantu bakeneye—vuba kandi mu buryo bwizerwa.
m3Sub: Yashyizwe mu buryo bwiza ku mafayiri n'amashusho manini
aboutLead: Tugabanya ubukomezi kandi tushyira hanze ibyiciro by'ingenzi. Tukemura ibibazo bishize mu mivugire y'inyandiko, ibikubiyemo, n'imikorere yo kongera umusaruro.
missionBody: Gerageza kare. Ubanza kubaka iby'ingenzi, hanyuma uvugurure ukurikije ibitekerezo.
principlesBody: UX yorohereje, imikorere yihuta, amadata make.
focusBody: OCR, gukora PDF, kureba amashusho n'amajwi, ibikoresho by'automatisation.
p1: Imigendekere ya OCR ku mbuga zascanwe: gukura amakuru, gushaka, guhuza mu ncamake, TTS—iyitaho ku bwizerwa binyuze mu gukora ibyo amakuru aho byo.
p2: Video player yihuta kandi yorohereje. Nta mitangaziranzi. Ihuzwa neza na iOS.
p4: Porogaramu ihuzwa na local AI kugira ngo ishoboce gukora ibintu mu buryo butandukanye no kuganira mu buryo bw'ibanga.
p5: Gutuma amafoto (screenshots) ya App Store byoroshye guhindura mu ndimi zitandukanye kugira ngo byoherezwe.
p6: Ikiganiro cy'ahantu hafi ishingiye ku bwemezabutumwe ukoresheje Bluetooth, hifashishijwe guhindura ururimi hakoreshejwe local AI niba ubishaka. Nta konti, nta saba ya central chat.
p7: Umuyobozi w'ibipapuro uzirondora aho uri. Yerekana coupon cyangwa ikarita y'ubunyamembership ikwiye mu gihe ugeze aho ugiye.
p3: Ibikoresho by'imbere bijyana n'ibyiciro bya App Store. Bishingiye kuri Swift/SwiftUI.
b2: Local AI no gukora imikorere by'automatic
q3: Gushyigikira imikorere itari kuri interineti/ingufu nke
servicesLead: Gusobanura neza ikibazo bituma itangwa ryihuta.
s2Body: Ohereza MVP, uyigerishe hakoreshejwe imikorere nyayo.
contactLead: Kopia itepele riri munsi kugira ngo usubize vuba.
footerLine1: Situdiyo ya software yibanda ku bikorwa
